unruled:carloan#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 109-110. The VIN on Schedule 1-A line 22, the substitute VIN and the statement for more than two VINs are filing information; the loan and vehicle tests are asked (carloan.requirements, carloan.vehicle).

unruled:clcw#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10; p550 p. 102. Canceled debt excluded from income (Form 982) is refused by s1.cod_unsupported, so no attribute reduction of the carryovers arises. As sd#1 of the backlog round.

unruled:clcw26#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10; p550 p. 103. Excluded canceled debt is refused by s1.cod_unsupported. Which spouse had a joint-return loss matters only on a 2026 separate return; the 2025 worksheet's carryover is the joint figure, and a 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:dcprov#1.evidence: i2441 pp. 2-3. dcprov is a collection with any number of providers; the box above line 1, the statement for providers beyond three and 'none' in column (a) are filing information.

unruled:dcprov#2.evidence: i2441 p. 2. dependent.dc_paid excludes 'care at a dependent care center that does not meet all applicable state and local regulations'.

unruled:dependent#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3. As dependent#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): f8863.ban asks about a post-2015 denial or reduction needing Form 8862 and the 2-year and 10-year bans; f8863.ban_refused refuses the American opportunity credit when it is Yes.

unruled:dependent#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 17-18. As dependent#3 of the backlog round: the Dependents-section boxes and the more-than-four statement are filing information; every dependent is entered and counted.

unruled:eic#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 40, 45. person.eic_ssn is asked for each person on the return (both spouses on a joint return; household.all_eic_ssn requires every person), and states that a 'Valid for Work Only With DHS Authorization' card is valid only while the authorization is valid.

unruled:eic#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 47. Notary public fees are refused by sc.statutory (sc.screened); Form 4029 and Form 4361 exemptions and other exempt self-employment income (an international social security agreement) are refused by person.se_screen (person.se_screened).

unruled:eic#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 40-41. Schedule EIC and the Dependents-section and address-block checkboxes are filing information; the qualifying-child tests are asked.

unruled:eic#4.evidence: i1040gi p. 42. The address-block checkbox is filing information; eic.us_home asks the fact.

unruled:f1040#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 23-24. s1.line8_other names wages earned while incarcerated (8u) and a nonqualified deferred compensation or nongovernmental 457 pension (8t) and refuses at s1.line9. As f1040#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): a chapter 11 estate is refused by scope.other_income and person.se_screen; married filing separately by s3.mfs.

unruled:f1040#2.evidence: i1040gi pp. 24-25. As f1040#2 of the backlog round (rechecked): scope.other_income names wages or tips not on a Form W-2, adoption benefits and other earned income (Form 1040 lines 1b to 1d and 1f to 1h); unreported and allocated tips are also refused by f8959.unsupported.

unruled:f1040#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 27-28. As f1040#3 of the backlog round (rechecked): retirement.special names nondeductible IRA contributions, conversions and recharacterizations, returned contributions, QCDs and HSA funding distributions; retirement.bad_code refuses Roth IRA codes other than Q. Rollovers are computed; the line 4c boxes and statement are filing information.

unruled:f1040#4.evidence: i1040gi pp. 28-31. As f1040#4 of the backlog round (rechecked): retirement.special names the retired public safety officer exclusion, the death benefit exclusion, terrorist-attack disability, pre-retirement-age disability pensions, corrective distributions and the Civil Service alternative annuity; box 5 contributions are subtracted (retirement.plan_excluded).

unruled:f1040#5.evidence: i1040gi p. 31. As f1040#5 of the backlog round (rechecked): ssb.pub915 refuses repayments above benefits, Forms 2555, 4563 and 8815, excluded adoption benefits and Puerto Rico income; ssb.terror_disability asks about terrorist-attack disability payments.

unruled:f1040#6.evidence: i1040gi p. 33. As f1040#6 of the backlog round (rechecked): sb.unsupported asks about any nominee income and refuses; the nominee statement and the line 7b box are filing information.

unruled:f1040#7.evidence: i1040gi pp. 14, 33-34. As f1040#7 of the backlog round (rechecked): married filing separately is refused (s3.mfs), so the spouse-itemizes and spouse-box rules do not arise; a spouse is entered only on a joint return; sa.unsupported refuses a disaster loss added to the standard deduction.

unruled:f1040#8.evidence: i1040gi p. 39. As f1040#8 of the backlog round: married filing separately is refused; line 26 is the supplied total of the filer's own payments; the former spouse's SSN is filing information.

unruled:f1040#9.evidence: p501 p. 6. household.married states the rule: 'if you divorced solely to file as unmarried, intending at the time to remarry each other in the next tax year, and actually do so, you must file as married in both years.'

unruled:f1095a#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 15, 17. As f1095a#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): f8962.married_in_2025 asks about a 2025 marriage with coverage before the first full month of marriage (a December marriage always has such coverage); f8962.marriage refuses lines 24 and 25.

unruled:f1095a#2.evidence: i8962 pp. 16-17; p974 p. 27. As f1095a#3/#4 of the backlog round (rechecked): f8962.alloc refuses any policy shared with another tax family, so no Part IV allocation arises; an enrolled individual in no tax family is refused by f8962.other.

unruled:f1095a#3.evidence: i8962 p. 16. As f1095a#2 of the backlog round (rechecked): f8962.other asks whether someone enrolled was not lawfully present and refuses lines 24 and 25.

unruled:f2441#1.evidence: i2441 p. 2; p503 pp. 3, 8, 10. dependent.dc_paid now states every listed rule: child support, agency reimbursement, chauffeur/bartender/gardener, schooling from kindergarten, overnight camp, summer school and tutoring, food/lodging/clothing/entertainment, noncompliant centers, the 8-hour out-of-home rule, days of work, mixed-purpose division, the qualifying-person period, housekeeper meals and lodging, employment taxes and the medical-expense bar (BUG-0334, BUG-0348).

unruled:f2441#2.evidence: i2441 p. 3; p503 p. 3. A dependent without an SSN, ITIN or ATIN, including a child born and died without an SSN, is refused by dependent.claimed_no_tin; column (c) and the attachment are filing information.

unruled:f4562#1.evidence: i4562 p. 5. f4562.line12 copies the return's Part I (s179): line 5 with the married-filing-separately 50% share and its refusal (s179.line5), the 2024 carryover (s179.line10) and the line 11 business income limit (s179.line11); a trade-in is refused by asset.screen and scveh.screen; asset.s179 requires use in the active conduct of the business.

unruled:f4562#10.evidence: i4562 pp. 14-15. asset.screen refuses listed property whose qualified business use is 50% or less after leaving out investment use, 5% owner and related-person leasing or compensation uses (the quoted exclusions); asset.pct handles conversion months; commuting miles and the section 280F limits are applied in scveh.

unruled:f4562#11.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-15. Line 27 is refused: listed property used 50% or less (asset.listed_low) gates asset.basis.

unruled:f4562#12.evidence: i4562 pp. 5, 13. Line 29 feeds Part I as s179.line7 (person.s179_listed); a section 179 election on property used 50% or less is refused by asset.after179 (asset.s179_bad) and listed property at 50% or less by asset.listed_low.

unruled:f4562#2.evidence: i4562 p. 9. Depreciation is figured on asset.after179 (basis less section 179) after the special allowance; software is refused by asset.screen unless its whole business cost is deducted in 2025 through section 179 and the special allowance; the percentage tables never exceed basis.

unruled:f4562#3.evidence: i4562 p. 9. asset.screen refuses an asset 'you disposed of' in 2025, but does not name the disposition of a portion of an asset, so the basis and reserve reduction for a partial disposition is unasked. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f4562#4.evidence: i4562 pp. 9, 11-12. asset.screen refuses like-kind exchanges and involuntary conversions, basis reductions other than section 179 and the special allowance, ADS, straight line and 150% elections, dispositions and short tax years; business use is asset.pct (converted property by months); the mid-quarter test is the mq form.

unruled:f4562#5.evidence: i4562 p. 10. Agricultural asset classes (01.x) map to 'outside' in class_lives (asset.outside, part of asset.screened), and farm income (Schedule F) is refused by scope.schedule1.

unruled:f4562#6.evidence: i4562 p. 11. Smart electric meters and grid systems are named in asset.screen; trees and vines bearing fruits or nuts are farm property (agricultural classes outside; Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1).

unruled:f4562#7.evidence: i4562 p. 12. Farming-business property is outside (agricultural classes 01.x, Schedule F refused by scope.schedule1), and a 150% declining balance election is refused by asset.screen.

unruled:f4562#8.evidence: i4562 pp. 11-13. asset.screen refuses property that must be depreciated under ADS (with examples) and an ADS election, and residential rental and nonresidential real property (real property is refused); Part III Section C is not reached.

unruled:f4562#9.evidence: i4562 pp. 13-14. Listed property used 50% or less is refused (asset.listed_low gates asset.basis); aircraft are refused by asset.screen; vehicles are scveh entries, whose first-year limits include the special allowance (auto_limit tables).

unruled:f4952#1.evidence: f4952 p. 3. As f4952#1 of the T-094 review (rechecked): f4952.line4d is Schedule D line 16 floored at zero (sd.line16 = sd.line7 + sd.line15), and those lines include the capital gain distributions (sd.line13) and the short- and long-term capital loss carryovers (sd.line6, sd.line14). The label does not name the carryovers; the amount includes them.

unruled:f5329#1.evidence: i5329 p. 5; p590b p. 28. retirement.exception names the exception but does not test its conditions (plan type, separation age, physician certification, reservist call-up, adoptee). Open in BUG-0369 (T-175). The 3-year emergency-distribution bar is refused by retirement.early_screen.

unruled:f5329#2.evidence: i5329 p. 5. The exception 19 statement is filing information.

unruled:f5329#3.evidence: i5329 p. 7. retirement.special refuses a 2024 or 2025 IRA contribution returned to you, with its earnings.

unruled:f5329#4.evidence: i5329 p. 8. f8889.unsupported refuses a withdrawal of excess HSA contributions or their earnings (in 2025 or by the 2025 due date including extensions); a later withdrawal is an amended-return matter.

unruled:f5695#1.evidence: i5695 p. 4. The Part I home address and the statement of additional addresses is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#10.evidence: i5695 p. 7. The line 29b, 29d and 29f QMID statements; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#2.evidence: i5695 p. 5. The line 17d main-home address is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#3.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 21c addresses is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#4.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 25b enabled-property code; f5695.line25a asks the eligibility is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#5.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 19e QMID statement; f5695.doors_no_qmid refuses an item without a QMID is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#6.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 20b QMID statement; f5695.windows_no_qmid refuses an item without a QMID is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#7.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 22b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#8.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 23b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f5695#9.evidence: i5695 p. 6. The line 24b QMID statement; items without a QMID are refused is filing information (as f5695#7 to #15 of the backlog round).

unruled:f8606#1.evidence: i8606 pp. 2, 9. Covered except one rule: person.ira_trad excludes contributions withdrawn with earnings and employer SEP/SIMPLE contributions; recharacterizations and excess contributions are refused by person.ira_excess. Open: no question adds a repayment of a qualified reservist distribution to line 1. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:f8606#2.evidence: i8606 p. 2. A traditional IRA distribution with basis from any year (including an inherited IRA) answers 'nondeductible contributions to any traditional IRA' in retirement.special, which refuses it; a Roth IRA distribution other than code Q is refused by retirement.bad_code. So no nontaxable part is left uncomputed.

unruled:f8863#1.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3, 8. dependent.edu_aoc (and person.edu_aoc) require household.all_tin and the institution's EIN (dependent.edu_ein); dependent.edu_student requires the student's TIN by the due date (dependent.tin; person.tin says issued by the due date). The filer-TIN reading is recorded as amb.2025.edu_filer_tin.

unruled:f8863#2.evidence: i8863 p. 1. dependent.edu_student requires dependent.edu_1098t (person.edu_1098t for the filers), which asks whether a Form 1098-T was received and states the exceptions (not required, or requested after February 2, 2026; amb.2025.edu_1098t_date).

unruled:f8880#1.evidence: f8880 p. 2. Line 2 is person.sav_line2 = person.sav_w2 (Form W-2 box 12 deferrals) + person.sav_voluntary + person.sav_simple. person.sav_voluntary excludes 'contributions designated under section 414(h)(2) (treated as employer contributions)'. Pick-ups are shown in box 14, not as box 12 deferrals, so they do not reach person.sav_w2.

unruled:f8889#1.evidence: i8889 p. 4. The line 1 self-only/family checkbox is filing information; no amount depends on it. The amounts use the coverage rules directly: f8889.dec_coverage (December 1 coverage, with the family rule for spouses) and the monthly coverage feed lines 3 and 6. The round-3 fixes (f8889.medical premiums; f8889.line2 and line14a trustee-to-trustee transfers, i8889 pp. 2-4) closed BUG-0414's two lows and drew no claim.

unruled:f8959#1.evidence: i8959 pp. 1-3. Line 8 sums person.se_line6, which is NonNegDollars per person (Schedule SE line 4c is floored at zero), so one spouse's loss never offsets the other's income.

unruled:f8962#1.evidence: i8962 pp. 3, 8. A filer or spouse someone can claim as a dependent is refused for the whole return by sa.dependent.

unruled:f8962#2.evidence: i8962 pp. 3, 6. A filer someone can claim as a dependent is refused for the whole return by sa.dependent.

unruled:f8962#3.evidence: i8962 p. 9. f8962.applicable takes the estimate exception only when f8962.aptc is true (APTC paid) and f8962.estimate_100 is Yes.

unruled:f8962#4.evidence: i8962 pp. 5, 14-15, 17. The f1095a.in_b_* and mo_b questions ask for the correct SLCSP premium when column B is wrong, naming a move and an unreported tax or coverage family change; f1095a.uniform lists the i8962 p. 15 changes and the no-APTC case (BUG-0366); a remaining zero is refused by f8962.b_zero.

unruled:f8962#5.evidence: i8962 pp. 14-15. f1095a.uniform tells the filer to use the corrected column B and to answer no if the correct amount is not the same every month, so line 10 follows the corrected premium (BUG-0366).

unruled:f8995#1.evidence: i8995 p. 3. qbi.dividends asks for box 5 dividends 'after confirming holding-period and related-payment requirements'.

unruled:ftc#1.evidence: i1116 p. 2. A foreign tax deduction on Schedule A is refused by sa.unsupported ('a foreign tax ... deduction'), so the credit and a deduction cannot both be taken.

unruled:g28#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 11. sales.special asks about the sale of 'an interest in a partnership, S corporation or trust ... that holds collectibles' and refuses it.

unruled:gift#1.evidence: i8283 pp. 1, 3: the attached statement of how a reduction was figured, and which form not to use, are filing instructions; no amount the tool computes depends on them.

unruled:gift#2.evidence: i8283 pp. 1-2: which section of Form 8283 the filer completes is presentation; the tool's gift groups apply the $500 and $5,000 thresholds (gift.special refuses Section B).

unruled:household#1.evidence: p501 p. 9. Test 1 reads dependent.parent_home_paid, which asks about the parent's main home (a rest home counts) for all of 2025 or the part the parent was alive.

unruled:household#2.evidence: p501 pp. 9-10. As household#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): dependent.kidnapped is asked and dependent.kidnap_residency refuses the residency of a kidnapped child, so head of household is not decided on it.

unruled:household#3.evidence: p501 p. 10; i1040gi p. 44. dependent.other_claimant asks whether the child is the qualifying child of another person, and dependent.qc_tiebreak refuses the tie-breaker case, so head of household is not allowed on a child another taxpayer can use.

unruled:interest#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 1-2. sb.unsupported names accrued market discount and a contingent payment debt instrument and refuses; tax-exempt interest is asked (f1040.tax_exempt_interest, net of premium) with exempt-interest dividends (div.box12); private activity bond interest is an AMT matter (s2.amt, div.amt).

unruled:ira#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. Married filing separately is refused for the whole return (s3.mfs), so the deemed-covered and lived-apart rules do not arise.

unruled:ira#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 96. A Form 8815 exclusion is refused by sb.unsupported ('a savings bond interest exclusion'); excluded employer-provided adoption benefits are refused by scope.other_income ('adoption benefits').

unruled:ira#3.evidence: i1040gi p. 95; p590a p. 35. person.ira_excess asks about contributions above $7,000/$8,000 or compensation, and person.ira_excess_gate refuses person.ira_line11.

unruled:ira#4.evidence: i1040gi p. 95. person.ira_trad excludes rollover contributions and separately billed trustees' fees.

unruled:ltc#1.evidence: i7206 pp. 1-2. sc.hi_screen refuses a retired public safety officer who paid premiums from retirement distributions and a more-than-2% S corporation shareholder; partnerships are not Schedule C (scope.schedule1). ltc.payments states the qualified contract requirements.

unruled:ltc#2.evidence: i7206 p. 2. sc.hi_screen refuses 'anyone ... covered by qualified long-term care insurance entered for more than one business on this return'.

unruled:mq#1.evidence: p946 p. 34. mq.q4 sums asset.mq_q4 per entry, whose basis is asset.after179 (business-use basis after section 179, before the special allowance); real property, same-year dispositions, non-MACRS methods and a short tax year are refused by asset.screen.

unruled:mq#2.evidence: p946 p. 34. As mq#1: mq.total sums asset.mqbase over 2025 assets; the excluded property is refused by asset.screen.

unruled:otjob#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 106, 108. otjob rows are per person: s1a.line14a_calc sums person.ot_total only over persons whose person.work_ssn (SSN valid for employment, issued by the due date including extensions) is Yes, so a spouse's overtime without a valid SSN does not reach line 14a; s1a.ot_ssn gates Part III.

unruled:person#1.evidence: i1040sse p. 4; i1040sc p. 14. As person#1 of the T-094 review (rechecked): sc.statutory asks whether the Schedule C is statutory employee income or notary public fees, and sc.screened refuses the Schedule C (sc.line1). So no such line 31 reaches person.se_line2, the SE tax deduction or the SEP or SIMPLE compensation.

unruled:person#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 95; i8606 p. 9. scope.other_income asks about 'a repayment to an IRA of a qualified reservist distribution (Form 8606 line 1)' and refuses the return, so no such repayment reaches person.ira_trad or Form 8606 line 1.

unruled:person#3.evidence: i8863 pp. 1, 3. As person#3 of the T-094 review (rechecked): f8863.ban asks about a post-2015 denial or reduction that needs Form 8862 and about the 2-year and 10-year bans, and f8863.ban_refused refuses the American opportunity credit (f8863.line7). person.edu_aoc feeds f8863.line1 through f8863.aoc_sum.

unruled:person#4.evidence: p590b p. 28. As person#4 of the T-094 review (rechecked): retirement.exc_amount tells the filer to enter, for exception 22, 'no more than 50% of the present value of the IRA or plan account'. The per-row amount is capped at 50% there, and person.x_c22 applies the $10,300 cap per person.

unruled:person#5.evidence: p590b p. 28. As person#5 of the T-094 review (rechecked): retirement.exc_amount tells the filer to enter, for exception 23, 'no more than your total interest in the IRA or plan account minus $1,000', and person.x_c23 applies the $1,000 cap. retirement.early_screen asks about 'an emergency personal expense distribution within 3 years after an earlier one you have not repaid' and refuses it (it refuses more than it must, never computes wrongly). person.x_two23 refuses more than one in a year.

unruled:qbi#1.evidence: i8995 pp. 2-3. Wrong: Schedule C QBI is computed (f8995.line2 sums person.qbi = sc.qbi, line 31 less sc.qbi_ded: the self-employment tax deduction, SEP/SIMPLE and Form 7206 amounts). The former-employee presumption is refused by sc.special ('services you provide to a business that employed you within the last 3 years').

unruled:qbi#2.evidence: i8995 pp. 4-5. f8995.line4 floors at zero and f8995.line16 reports lines 2 and 3 combined when less than zero.

unruled:qdcg#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 38. The Form 2555 exclusion is refused (s1.line8_other names line 8d; sa.excluded_income asks Form 2555), so the Foreign Earned Income Tax Worksheet footnote never applies; qdcg.line1's label repeats the form's text.

unruled:qdcg#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 38. As qdcg#1 for the Form 2555 footnote; the line 7b checkbox is filing information.

unruled:refund#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 89; p525 p. 24. A recovery of another earlier-year deduction (real estate taxes, sales taxes) is a line 8z item of kind recovery, refused by oi8z.recovery.

unruled:retirement#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 27. The statement explaining a rollover into a qualified plan, or one made in 2026, is an attachment; the amount rolled over is asked (retirement.rollover) and excluded. The round-3 fix to retirement.rollover (non-eligible distributions, nonspouse beneficiaries, code S) and the wrongful-levy refusal in retirement.special closed BUG-0414's low (p575 pp. 21, 24; p560 p. 18; i5329 p. 2; rechecked: correct).

unruled:retirement#2.evidence: i5329 p. 5. As retirement#4 of the T-094 round: the statement with the child's or eligible adoptee's name, age and TIN (or the death documentation) is an attachment; exception 19's conditions are stated in retirement.exception and its $5,000 cap is applied.

unruled:retirement#3.evidence: p575 pp. 17, 34; i1099r pp. 13, 15. As screen group 9 and 10, finding 1: retirement.plan_simple subtracts box 5 (retirement.plan_excluded) for any plan distribution, periodic or not, and box 5 is the employee's cost 'that the employee may recover tax free this year', which the payer must 'make every effort to compute' (box 2b). The pro-rata, separate-contract, pre-1987 and beneficiary-discharge rules are how that amount is figured. The round-3 fix (retirement.annuity, and retirement.special for single-sum, full-discharge and reduced-payment nonperiodic payments on or after the annuity starting date) closed BUG-0414's low; the single-sum payment treated as received before the starting date is refused.

unruled:s1#1.evidence: p504 p. 14. As s1#3 of round 2: attaching the instrument that designates payments as not alimony, each year, is filing information; s1.alimony_received leaves designated payments out. A temporary support order is itself the instrument. The round-3 fix (third-party payments and life insurance premiums in s1.alimony_received and s1.alimony_paid, p504 pp. 13-14) closed BUG-0414's low and drew no claim.

unruled:s1#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 93. As s1#1 of the refresh round and of round 2 (rechecked): person.eligible_educator states the 900-hour test; person.educator_expenses excludes home schooling and nonathletic health or PE supplies and states the reductions (Form 8815, QTP and Coverdell, unreported reimbursements).

unruled:s1#3.evidence: i1040gi pp. 98-99; p4681 p. 5. Married filing separately is refused (s3.mfs) and sli.eligible requires a status other than mfs and sli.claimed_count 0 (the dependency bar); sli.interest states the qualified student loan definition (mixed-use and related-person lender included) and excludes interest paid from tax-free QTP earnings and, since the round-3 fix that closed BUG-0414's low, interest paid through the NHSC and state health-service loan repayment programs; sli.line1 caps at sli.max ($2,500); the Pub. 970 exception (Form 2555 or 4563, excluded Puerto Rico income) is refused at sli.line1 (sa.excluded_income).

unruled:s179#1.evidence: i4562 p. 5; p946 p. 17. s179.line2 sums the business cost of section 179 property (asset.cost179 from asset.basis); asset.s179 excludes land and improvements, investment property, leased property (with the lessor exceptions), and tax-exempt, governmental and foreign-person use; use outside the United States, trade-ins and like-kind exchanges are refused by asset.screen.

unruled:s179#2.evidence: p946 p. 18. Vehicles are scveh entries: scveh.suv and scveh.suv_cap apply the $31,300 limit, and scveh.s179_bad refuses an election above it.

unruled:s179#3.evidence: p946 pp. 18-19. A joint return that replaces separate returns after the due date is an amended-return matter; the tool prepares the original return, and a separate return with a section 179 election is refused (s179.line5).

unruled:s179#4.evidence: p946 p. 19; i4562 p. 5. A business without material participation is refused (sc.passive feeds sc.screened); section 1231 gains (Form 4797) are refused by scope.schedule1 and an NOL deduction by s1.line8_other; working-capital interest is omitted, which can only lower line 11.

unruled:s179#5.evidence: i4562 p. 5. The first point is wrong: s179.show10 hides line 10 on the values sheet only; the value is computed either way (spec, shown_when), so the 2024 carryover reaches line 13. Open: the s179.line10 question does not exclude carryover attributable to qualified section 179 real property. Low; BUG-0402.

unruled:s1a#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 109. s1a.carloan routes to the carloan entries: carloan.requirements (originated after 2024, first lien, not related, personal use) and carloan.vehicle (new, on-road, under 14,000 pounds, U.S. assembly); carloan.kind covers an inherited loan; carloan.mixed and refi_* limit negative equity, insurance and refinancing.

unruled:s2#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 112; i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029, an international social security agreement, community income on a separate return, a chapter 11 case and a U.S. citizen employed by a foreign government; notary fees are refused by sc.statutory.

unruled:s8812#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 18; i1040s8812 p. 1. As s8812#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): a filer who can be claimed is refused for the whole return (sa.dependent); dependent.married asks the married-child test; a child born and died without an SSN is refused by dependent.claimed_no_tin; the adopted-child citizen exception is stated in dependent.citizen.

unruled:s8812#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 19; i1040s8812 p. 2. As s8812#2 of the backlog round: dependent.odc_person requires dependent.claimed, which applies the qualifying-relative tests and sa.dependent.

unruled:s8812#3.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 3. As s8812#3 of the backlog round: an optional method is refused by person.se_screen; treaty-excluded income is a Schedule 1 line 8 exclusion refused by s1.line8_other.

unruled:s8812#4.evidence: i1040s8812 p. 8. As s8812#5 of the backlog round: married filing separately is refused (s3.mfs) and community income on a separate return by person.se_screen, so community wages do not arise.

unruled:sa#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 33. person.blind now states the partial-blindness test and the certified statement (BUG-0347).

unruled:sa#2.evidence: i1040sca p. 1. Married filing separately is refused for the whole return (scope.ready, s3.mfs).

unruled:sa#3.evidence: i1040sca p. 11. gift.deduction states the good-used-condition rule and the $250 contemporaneous written acknowledgment (BUG-0319).

unruled:sales#1.evidence: i1040sd pp. 5-6; p550 p. 81. sd.other_forms asks whether there are gains or losses 'from (or that belong on) Forms 4797, 2439, 6252' and refuses Schedule D: a section 475(f) trader's securities, an SBIC stock loss and a section 1244 ordinary loss belong on Form 4797 Part II, and an installment sale on Form 6252. Reporting the whole gain on Form 8949 is how a seller elects out of the installment method.

unruled:sales#2.evidence: p550 p. 88; i1040sd p. 6. Further holding-period details beyond the round-3 sales.box list (rechecked: correct): the premium of an unexercised written option is short-term, a purchased option that expired is treated as sold on its expiration date, a securities futures contract to sell gives short-term gain or loss, and stock received in a demutualization has its own holding period. Rare; low.

unruled:sales#3.evidence: i8949 pp. 5, 11. As sales#5 of round 2 (rechecked): sb.unsupported names 'accrued market discount' and 'a contingent payment debt instrument' and refuses Schedule B, so a sale with code D or ordinary CPDI gain does not reach Form 1040; sales.code 'other' (codes D, O) is refused by sales.bad_code. The round-3 wording of sales.code (code E) does not change this.

unruled:sales#4.evidence: p550 p. 88. sales.wash_loss gives the 30-day window; for a REMIC residual interest the window is 6 months and comparable taxable mortgage pool interests count as replacements. Rare; low.

unruled:sales#5.evidence: i8949 p. 6. The explanation of a basis other than cost is an attachment to Form 8949; the corrected basis is entered as an amount (sales.correct_basis). As the earlier presentation rulings.

unruled:sb#1.evidence: i1040sb pp. 2-3. The line 7a answer is a yes/no on the form; no amount depends on it, and the question already asks about financial interest or signature authority without any FBAR exception.

unruled:sc#1.evidence: i1040sc pp. 6-7. As sc#2 of the refresh round: scveh.smr_ok asks the first-year, whole-lease and five-vehicle rules; scveh.lease_smr_bad refuses actual expenses on a leased vehicle after the standard rate. The Part IV statement for additional vehicles is filing information.

unruled:sc#2.evidence: i1040sc p. 13. As sc#3 of the refresh round: a home is real property, refused by asset.screen, so no home depreciation or section 179 reaches line 13.

unruled:sc#3.evidence: i7206 p. 2. As sc#4 of the refresh round: ltc.payments excludes months the person was eligible for a long-term care plan subsidized by an employer (the separate test for long-term care plans).

unruled:sc#4.evidence: i1040sc pp. 1, 14. As sc#1 of the refresh round: a section 461(l) excess business loss adjustment (Form 461, Schedule 1 line 8p) is named and refused by s1.line8_other.

unruled:sc#5.evidence: i1040sc p. 5. As sc#5 of the refresh round: the Form 1099-NEC difference statement is filing information.

unruled:sc#6.evidence: i1040sc p. 8. As sc#6 and sc#7 of the refresh round: the statements and margin notations for lines 16a and 16b are filing information; the interest is entered.

unruled:sc#7.evidence: i1040sc pp. 3-5. The header entries (lines A, B, D, E, H and I) are filing information; no amount depends on them.

unruled:scope#1.evidence: p575 p. 35. retirement.special names 'a qualified disaster recovery distribution (whatever the code in box 7), or a repayment of one, or a recontribution of a distribution to purchase or construct a main home that was canceled because of a qualified disaster (Form 8915-F)' (BUG-0408) and refuses the distribution's taxable amount; scope.other_income asks the 2023 and 2024 parts and repayments.

unruled:scope#2.evidence: i1040gi p. 36. As scope#2 of the refresh round: f1040.gate.sdtw routes the Schedule D Tax Worksheet when Schedule D line 18 or 19 is more than zero (sd.line18 and sd.line19 are figured from Form 1099-DIV boxes 2d and 2b) or Form 4952 line 4g has an election (sd.investment_election).

unruled:scope#3.evidence: i1040sse p. 1. As scope#3 of the refresh round: person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029 or Form 4361 and refuses Schedule SE.

unruled:scveh#1.evidence: i1040sc p. 8; p946 p. 59. As scveh#1 of the refresh round and round 2 (rechecked): sc.special names 'an inclusion amount for leased property' and sc.screened refuses the business; the conversion part is scveh.lease_smr_before.

unruled:scveh#2.evidence: i1040sc p. 6. sc.method_other asks whether the business must capitalize costs under the uniform capitalization rules (section 263A) because it is not a small business taxpayer (gross receipts above $31 million, or a tax shelter), and sc.screened refuses the business; a small business taxpayer is exempt (p538 p. 17), so no vehicle cost is capitalized. The round-3 fixes (scveh.cost: destination charges, dealer preparation, gas guzzler tax; scveh.screen: substantial improvements and any 2025 investment use, which refuses more than it must) closed BUG-0414's two lows (p463 pp. 25-26, i4562 p. 14; rechecked: correct).

unruled:scveh#3.evidence: i1040sc p. 7; i4562 p. 13. As scveh#4 of round 2: whether the vehicle information goes in Schedule C Part IV or Form 4562 Part V is filing information; no amount depends on it.

unruled:sd#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 10. As sd#1 of the backlog round (rechecked): a 2025 separate return is refused (s3.mfs), clcw.spouse_screen refuses a carryover from a 2024 joint return without the same spouse, and excluded canceled debt is refused by s1.cod_unsupported.

unruled:sd#2.evidence: i1040sd p. 10. As sd#2 of the backlog round: the QOF box and Form 8997 Part III are filing information; QOF codes are refused by sales.bad_code.

unruled:sdtw#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 16. A smaller amount on the line 4e dotted line is an alternative allocation, refused by f4952.alternative_allocation ('Only the default capital-gain-first allocation is supported').

unruled:se#1.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names self-employment income 'earned as a U.S. citizen employed by a foreign government' and refuses Schedule SE.

unruled:se#2.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names a chapter 11 bankruptcy case and community income on a separate return; a separate return is also refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:se#3.evidence: i1040sse p. 2. person.se_screen names an approved Form 4029 and self-employment income exempt under an international social security agreement.

unruled:ssb#1.evidence: i1040gi pp. 31-32. As ssb#1 of the refresh round: the line 6d checkbox is for married filing separately, which is refused (s3.mfs).

unruled:tax_on_amount#1.evidence: i1040gi p. 68. The tax_table columns map qss to the joint column ('This column must also be used by a qualifying surviving spouse').

unruled:u1250#1.evidence: i1040sd p. 13. sales.special asks about the sale of an interest in a partnership that holds section 1250 property and refuses it.

unruled:u1250#2.evidence: i1040sd p. 13. A sale of depreciated real property (for example a converted vacation home) is refused by sales.special ('depreciable real property (section 1250 property)'); installment sales are refused by sd.other_forms (Form 6252).

unruled:w2#1.evidence: i8959 p. 1. w2.box5 feeds only Form 8959 (person.medicare5); f8959.unsupported names 'Medicare wages on a wage statement from a U.S. territory (such as Form 499R-2/W-2PR)' and refuses Form 8959.

unruled:w2#2.evidence: i8959 p. 1. As w2#1: w2.box6 feeds only Form 8959 (person.medicare6), refused by f8959.unsupported for a Form 499R-2/W-2PR.

unruled:w2#3.evidence: iw2w3 p. 21; f1040s2 line 17h. The additional tax on code Z income is a Schedule 2 amount; s2.other asks about 'any amount on Schedule 2' other than the taxes this tool figures and refuses.

unruled:w2#4.evidence: iw2w3 pp. 17, 20; f1040s2 line 17k. The excise tax on golden parachute payments is a Schedule 2 amount, refused by s2.other.

unruled:w2#5.evidence: i2441 p. 5. As w2#4 of the refresh round: s8812.combat_pay asks about nontaxable combat pay and refuses Form 2441 lines 4, 5, 18 and 19.
